differences.justification: SQLite does not implement ROLLUP. The query fails loudly instead of returning rows. Engine capability gap; no row difference is possible.
SQLite does not implement GROUPING() or grouping sets. The query fails loudly instead of returning rows. Engine capability gap; no row difference is possible.
SQLite has no STDDEV_SAMP aggregate. The query fails loudly instead of returning rows. Engine capability gap; no row difference is possible.

SQLite rejects parenthesised operands of EXCEPT. The fork generator does not wrap them as subselects, so the query fails loudly. Tracked by sqlite-tpcds-parenthesised-compound-operands; remove this entry when the generator is fixed.

SQLite without indexes does not finish these multi-join queries inside the per-query budget at SF0.01. The outcome depends on wall-clock speed, so the entry is optional. Performance limit of the engine on unindexed TPC-DS, not a translation difference.

SQLite without indexes does not finish TPC-H Q21 inside the per-query budget at SF0.01. The outcome depends on wall-clock speed, so the entry is optional. Performance limit of the engine on unindexed TPC-H, not a translation difference.
